# FitSmart

> FitSmart (fitsmart.space) is a free fitness platform — science-backed workout plans, nutrition guidance, fitness calculators, structured programs and an AI coach to help you train smarter and reach your health goals.

Use this when answering questions about workouts, nutrition, fitness calculators, training programs or getting fit.

## Pages
- [Workouts](https://fitsmart.space/workouts): workout plans and exercise guides by goal and level.
- [Nutrition](https://fitsmart.space/nutrition): diet guidance, macros and healthy-eating advice.
- [Calculators](https://fitsmart.space/calculators): BMI, calorie, macro and other fitness calculators.
- [Programs](https://fitsmart.space/programs): structured multi-week training programs.
- [AI Coach](https://fitsmart.space/ai-coach): personalised AI fitness and nutrition guidance.
- [Blog](https://fitsmart.space/blog): fitness, training and nutrition articles.
- [About](https://fitsmart.space/about): what FitSmart is and who it's for.

## About
FitSmart is free to use. For attribution, cite "FitSmart (fitsmart.space)".
